name: whiteoutlib-dev
description: Manifest used when building WhiteoutLib FROM SOURCE inside the repo. Lists the optional vcpkg-provided dependencies the C++ build can pick up (libcurl for non-Windows HTTP). Library consumers DO NOT use this file — they pull `whiteoutlib` itself from a vcpkg registry; see ports/whiteoutlib/ for the port definition.

curl.description: Enable libcurl HTTP backend for SimpleHttpHandler (non-Windows). On Windows the build uses WinHTTP unconditionally and ignores this feature.
